Parking

A place to find cars and recycle items.

Activités

Install a battery and an engine, then add Fuel Bottles. A recycler is also available here.

Principaux gains

Cars have different seating capacities; some carry an unlocked 25-slot boot.

Risques

Cars have no owner. Watch for other players while using the recycler.

Recycler

There is a recycler here. It breaks down recyclable items and makes noise while running.
